newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan, Uzbekistan sign economic agreement.
newsitem.headline: Jordan, Uzbekistan sign economic agreement.

text.p: Jordan and Uzbekistan signed an economic accord on Saturday aimed at boosting trade between the two countries, Uzbek Foreign Minister Abdulaziz Komilov told reporters.
The accord, signed by Komilov and Jordanian Minister of Trade and Industry Ali Abu al-Ragheb, is the first signed between Jordan and the former Soviet republic.
Jordan sees Uzbekistan as a rich source of raw materials and minerals, and also hopes to find a market in Uzbekistan for its exports of fruit, vegetables, pharmaceuticals and construction materials.
Komilov, on a brief visit to Jordan, said the agreement also aimed at encouraging investment in the two countries and boosting the role of the private sector.
